# 2.16.17 Textbox.ZIndex

> Source: [MS-RDL] v20251031 — pages PDF 184–184.
> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

2.16.17
Textbox.ZIndex
The Textbox.ZIndex element specifies the drawing order of a Textbox within its container. This
element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an Integer ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.3.17). If the Textbox.ZIndex element is not present, its value is interpreted as 0. The
value of this element MUST be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 2147483647.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.ZIndex element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.ZIndex element.
 <xsd:element name="ZIndex" type="xsd:unsignedInt" minOccurs="0" />
